outline: 本課程介紹物理學的基本觀念,並訓練學生運用這些基本觀念來解決科學問題, 內容包括碰撞、轉動、力矩、角動量、靜力平衡、簡諧運動及波等主題
schedule:
1. Momentum, Impulse, and Collision (I)
2. Momentum, Impulse, and Collision (II)
3. Momentum, Impulse, and Collision (III)
4. Rotation of rigid bodies (I)
5. Rotation of rigid bodies (II)
6. Dynamics of rotational motion (I)
7. Dynamics of rotational motion (II)
8. Review
9. Exam 1
10. Dynamics of rotational motion (III)
11. Equilibrium and elasticity (I)
12. Equilibrium and elasticity (II)
13. Periodic motion (I)
14. Periodic motion (II)
15. Mechanical waves (I)
16. Mechanical waves (II)
17. Review
18. Exam 2
materials:
教科書: University Physics by Young and Freedman, Vol. 1, 14 Ed, Pearson
高立圖書
resources:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
